title: Dashboard and screen layout
summary: Feedback centers on the dashboard, screen, and cabin layout, with positive comments praising clarity, appearance, and ease of use while many other mentions are too brief or ambiguous to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the layout for looking smart, presenting key information clearly, and making the dashboard, touchscreen, and cabin easy to understand and use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions refer to interior, dashboard, screen, or personal layout but often lack enough context to confirm whether the comment is favorable or unfavorable.

limitations: Many undetermined fragments are very short or ambiguous, so the available examples are insufficient to fully characterize all layout-related feedback.
One undetermined fragment mentions a personal instrument-cluster layout being dropped, which may reflect a different issue from general dashboard or cabin layout feedback.
